previous_audit_defects: Curated hard-negative subset blindly assumed all source records were benign.
Threshold selection lacked Pareto analysis and engineering justifications.
Calibration only measured Brier score without fitting a calibrator.
Lacked explicit Wilson confidence intervals for FPR/Recall.
Hard-negative taxonomy was keyword-based without verifying ground-truth labels.
dataset_gaps: Multilingual coverage is fundamentally insufficient for testing (e.g., Hinglish N=18).
Certain threat vectors lack statistical sample size.
model_defects: Systematic failure on Curated Benign Hard Negatives (FPR = 39.02%). The model conflates urgent institutional semantics with maliciousness.
remaining_blockers: Unacceptably high False Positive Rate on critical legitimate institutional notifications.
